exclusion_buffer.rule: Exclude all observations between development cutoff and validation start from formal validation

temporal_partitioning.validation_start_rule: First fully closed UTC 15m boundary at least 30 minutes after H39_PROTOCOL_FREEZE_SHA

m6_support_determination.causal_guarantee: Closed-form algebraic identity derived strictly from contemporaneously stored L2 book metrics; no future data or candle interpolation required

features.name: Trade Notional Imbalance (5m)
features.hypothesis: Aggressive buyer-initiated trade flow over 5m predicts positive short-term price movement

features.name: Trade Notional Imbalance (15m)
features.hypothesis: Persistent aggressive buyer-initiated trade flow over 15m predicts positive price movement

features.name: Order Flow Imbalance (5m)
features.hypothesis: Best-level order flow imbalance over 5m predicts positive price movement

features.name: Top-5 Book Depth Imbalance (5m)
features.hypothesis: Resting top-5 order book bid depth exceeding ask depth over 5m predicts positive price movement

features.name: Top-20 Book Depth Imbalance (5m)
features.hypothesis: Resting top-20 order book bid depth exceeding ask depth over 5m predicts positive price movement

features.name: Microprice Deviation from Mid (1m)
features.hypothesis: Microprice resting above mid price over the final 1m predicts positive price movement

features.name: Microstructure Pressure Agreement Score
features.hypothesis: Unanimous agreement across trade flow, OFI, depth, and microprice predicts stronger directional momentum

features.name: Trade vs Book Pressure Divergence Score
features.hypothesis: Aggressive trade flow pushing against opposing resting order book depth predicts directional breakthrough

causal_execution_and_outcomes.decision_boundary: Closed UTC 15m boundary (HH:00, HH:15, HH:30, HH:45)
causal_execution_and_outcomes.decision_latency_rule: All feature events must strictly satisfy event_time_ms <= decision_ms and receive_time_ms <= decision_ms
causal_execution_and_outcomes.reference_entry_rule: OPEN of first fully available 1m bar strictly after decision close (decision_close_ms + 60_000)
causal_execution_and_outcomes.secondary_horizon_role: SUPPORTING_ONLY (cannot rescue negative primary horizon result)
causal_execution_and_outcomes.excursion_atr_rule: ATR(14) on 15m bars frozen at decision time

baseline_model.incremental_information_test: Likelihood ratio test and t-statistic of microstructure coefficient beyond baseline

statistical_testing_and_multiple_testing.hypothesis_test: One-sided test: H0: signed_effect <= 0 vs H1: signed_effect > 0 under frozen predefined signs

required_conditions: No sequence gap or PU continuity failure in feature window
No missing book sample interval (> 10s without sample)
No missing trade interval (> 60s without trade during active market)
Strictly causal event and receive timestamps

requirements: Fresh post-freeze validation satisfies all maturity gates
95% CI strictly excludes zero in correct direction
Statistically significant incremental value beyond price/context baseline
provisional_candidate_gate.stop_rule: If no feature passes or effect is negative, status is RESEARCH_FAMILY_STOP (or FORWARD_DATA_INSUFFICIENT if validation immature)

safety_invariants.final_holdout_prohibition: Zero rows read, zero bytes accessed
